_note: Each animal's body in battle (scripts/fx/unit_view.gd, model_stage.gd, battle_field.gd). size: how big it's drawn, its longest side in field tiles (a bird's wingspan, an upright animal's height), whatever its model's own proportions; a Mythic's is its hero size. limits: how big animals may look on the screen, as a share of the screen's height: average_target_pct is what a typical animal should be in a normal fight (Clash Royale's are 5-7%), unit_max_pct the most any animal may be (the biggest Tanks) and hero_max_pct the most a Mythic hero may be; the camera never zooms in past them (battle_field.gd; it stops camera_margin_pct short, for the breathing, leaning and turning a pose adds), the feel report measures them (tests/feel_report.gd SIZE) and tests/test_sizes.gd fails if one is over. Elite Specialists are drawn feel.json army elite_scale bigger.
